create_audio_codec_subclass: create a subclass of AudioCodec that implements _load_encoder and _load_decoder abstract methods
load_transmitter_encoder: load a transmitter encoder model from a checkpoint file onto the specified device
load_receiver_models: load both receiver encoder and decoder models from checkpoint files for audio decoding
create_audio_codec_streamer_subclass: create a subclass of AudioCodecStreamer that implements _encode and _decode abstract methods for streaming
run_audio_stream: run the AudioCodecStreamer to stream audio from input device to output device with encoder and decoder processing
